source.title: Dataset for: Accidental self-ignition of hydrogen released from pressurized cylinder (Figures 7-9)

eligibility.include_only: public actual-hydrogen pressure-release time series with documented initial state or recoverable source conditions and a pressure-releasing restriction

claim_boundary: A pass can support only a prospective public component pressure-release validation claim for the documented cylinder/restriction domain. It does not validate ignition probability, flame, radiation, dispersion, detector placement, station control, ESD, station-to-vehicle behavior or field safety.
